prompts.title: Reply to an email politely
prompts.text:
Write a short, polite reply to the email below. Keep it friendly but professional, and end with a clear next step.

Email:
[paste email]

prompts.title: Meeting notes to action items
prompts.text:
Turn these meeting notes into a list of action items. For each item, add who owns it and the deadline if it was mentioned.

Notes:
[paste notes]

prompts.title: Make it shorter
prompts.text:
Cut this text to about half its length. Keep the main points and my tone. Don't add anything new.

[paste text]

prompts.title: Fix grammar only
prompts.text:
Fix grammar and spelling mistakes in the text below. Don't change my style or rewrite whole sentences.

[paste text]

prompts.title: Blog post outline
prompts.text: Give me an outline for a blog post about [topic]. Include a title, 5 to 7 section headings, and one line under each heading.

prompts.title: Code review
prompts.text:
Review this code like a senior developer. Point out bugs, unclear names, and anything that could break. Suggest fixes with short code examples.

[paste code]

prompts.title: Explain this error
prompts.text:
Explain what this error means in simple words, what usually causes it, and how to fix it.

Error:
[paste error]

prompts.title: Write unit tests
prompts.text:
Write unit tests for the function below. Cover normal cases, edge cases, and bad input.

[paste function]

prompts.title: Explain like I'm new
prompts.text: Explain [concept] to someone who is new to it. Use one simple example, then give me 3 quick questions to check if I understood.

prompts.title: Summarize a paper
prompts.text:
Summarize this paper in 5 points: the problem, the method, the main result, the limits, and why it matters.

[paste abstract or text]
